about: Client UI (Noesis) one-frame event: for every local-player view-model object removed from the VMLocalPlayerDataSingletonComponent collection, the registration system creates a fresh entity carrying this component with the object pointer, so UI code can drop it; gui::vmplayer::VMPlayerUnregisteredCleanupSystem reads it. Same pattern as Script Extender's VMInventoryUnregisteredOneFrameComponent / VMCombatUnregisteredOneFrameComponent. Never seen alive (no seen.py samples).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x12A9920 (AllocRaw 8) writes 0 and registers destructor bg3.exe+0x1207D80, which calls the Release slot (+0x20 of the virtual table at +0x10 of the pointee) on *this: an intrusive Noesis::Ptr. bg3.exe+0x12A9A90 (part of gui::registration::VMPlayerRegistrationSystem, local players) takes each object out of a Noesis::BaseCollection, creates an entity, adds this component and stores the pointer (AddRef slot +0x18 / Release slot +0x20). Value type presumably Noesis::Ptr<gui::VMLocalPlayer> (the Data singleton's value type), written as void* like SE's VMInventoryUnregisteredOneFrameComponent::Object.

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: Pointee class (gui::VMLocalPlayer) taken from the Data singleton by analogy, not read from this component's own code.
